title: Statistic: the percentage sum is not equal to 100%
symptom: In the statistics page, the percentages for High, Low, and In range do not sum to 100% because the values are truncated (not rounded), e.g., the sum equals 98% in the screenshot.
cause: The percentages are calculated using integer division (implicit flooring), which truncates the decimal parts, causing the sum to be less than 100%.
fix: Round the High and Low percentages to the nearest integer and calculate the In range percentage as 100% minus the sum of the rounded High and Low percentages. A PR (#1498) was proposed to implement this.
evidence_quote: The 3 values are truncated (not rounded), so the sum equals 98% in this screenshot and not 100% My suggestion would be to round the High and Low percentages to the nearest integer value and calculate the "in range value" with 100% complement
